answer: Make each identity prove it holds a unique, randomly assigned dataset, checked by spot audits that fail the moment two agents present the same bytes. One honest agent keeps one lotus of data alive cheaply, but a farm running a thousand clones must buy a thousand distinct stores, because copying a name is free while copying provable storage is not. A zephyr of duplicate claims is caught at the first audit, and the sonnet of cost rises with every fake added.
